step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows Quantis's multi-tenant SaaS application running on AWS. Multi-tenant user traffic (Tenant A and Tenant B) accesses the platform guarded by AWS WAF and authenticated via Amazon Cognito. Validated web traffic flows through an Application Load Balancer (ALB) to containerized microservices running on AWS Fargate in a Multi-AZ configuration. The Fargate services interact bidirectionally with an Amazon RDS MySQL database (Multi-AZ with master-slave replication and encryption at rest). Deployment of updated container images is managed by Amazon ECR providing Docker images to AWS CodeDeploy, which performs blue-green deployments onto AWS Fargate.

edges.notes: Tenant A routes requests through AWS WAF.
Tenant B routes requests through AWS WAF.
WAF forwards verified traffic to ALB.
ALB routes web requests to Fargate application tasks.
Fargate tasks query RDS MySQL database.
RDS MySQL responds to query requests.
CodeDeploy pulls Docker images from ECR.
CodeDeploy performs zero-downtime blue-green deployments to Fargate.
